_help: Racquet Sports micro-site data. Edit this file to update the Open Drills calendar, Community Play calendar, rotating event cards, and pro bios. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Day numbers: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday ... 6=Saturday. Expired events disappear automatically. Each weekly item may carry startsOn/endsOn (YYYY-MM-DD) so seasons can overlap; seasonStart only changes the header label.

pros.name: Neil Kenner
pros.title: Director of Racquet Sports / Tennis Professional
pros.about: Neil brings more than 20 years of coaching experience to The J, with a background competing at both the collegiate and professional levels. He has coached players at every stage of the game, from recreational and developing players to collegiate and professional athletes. As Racquet Sports Director, Neil is passionate about creating a welcoming community where players can improve, compete, and connect.
pros.style: Neil brings energy, positivity, and purpose to the court. His coaching focuses on movement, consistency, smart decision-making, and realistic point situations. He challenges players to improve while keeping the experience encouraging, competitive, and enjoyable.
credentials: Former SMU Women's Tennis Assistant Coach

pros.name: Polo Cruz
pros.title: Adult Tennis Program Manager / Tennis Professional
pros.about: Polo has coached tennis at the JCC for 28 years and is a certified USPTR Professional. His lifelong connection to tennis began as a junior player in Texas before competing at Hillcrest High School and Lindenwood University. His coaching experience includes Fair Oaks Tennis Center and Lakehill Preparatory School, where he led the boys' team to a State Doubles Championship and third-place state finish.
pros.style: Polo focuses on building strong fundamentals through proper form, technique, and repetition. He works especially well with beginners and players rebuilding or refining their game, helping each player develop greater confidence, consistency, and a deeper understanding of tennis.
credentials: Hillcrest High School and Lindenwood University

pros.name: Curtis Reese
pros.title: Pickleball Program Manager / Pickleball & Tennis Professional
pros.about: Curtis brings extensive tennis and pickleball experience to The J. A former collegiate tennis player with a degree in Kinesiology, he began his professional coaching career at the JCC before coaching at Brookhaven and Las Colinas Country Clubs. Curtis began playing pickleball in 2018 and has since coached at T Bar M and served as Pickleball Director at Greenhill.
pros.style: Curtis brings his experience across both tennis and pickleball to every player he works with. His goal is to help players strengthen their game, build confidence, and enjoy their time on the court, whether they are developing their tennis skills or taking their pickleball game to the next level.
credentials: Collegiate tennis at the NJCAA and Division II levels

pros.name: Cameron Vose
pros.title: Youth Tennis Program Manager / Tennis & Pickleball Professional
pros.about: Cameron brings 16 years of tennis coaching and five years of pickleball coaching experience to The J, along with experience coaching padel. He played four years of collegiate tennis and earned a bachelor's degree in English with a minor in Coaching from Hardin-Simmons University. His career has included serving as a Director of Racquet Sports in Maui and Director of Pickleball in Nantucket.
pros.style: Cameron brings positivity and high energy to every session. He believes attitude and work ethic play a major role in success and enjoys setting goals with athletes and helping them reach them. His coaching emphasizes strong technique, mental toughness, and creating confident competitors on and off the court.

pros.name: James McAvoy
pros.title: Tennis Professional
pros.about: James brings collegiate playing experience and more than 15 years of coaching to The J. He played Division I tennis at Creighton University and achieved an ITF ranking of No. 361 in the U.S. Since beginning his coaching career in 2010, James has worked with players across ages and skill levels, helping each player continue progressing through their own tennis journey.
pros.style: James is passionate about introducing players to tennis and helping them develop at every age and skill level. His approach meets players where they are while building the skills, confidence, and understanding they need to continue progressing.

pros.name: John Gervasio
pros.title: Tennis Professional
pros.about: John brings 31 years of experience as a tennis teaching professional, including 12 years at the JCC. His career has taken him across Florida, Indiana, and Texas, giving him decades of experience teaching and developing players. John is an RSPA Elite Professional and brings a seasoned, professional approach to instruction and player development.
pros.style: With more than three decades of teaching experience, John brings a knowledgeable and experienced approach to the court, helping players strengthen their skills and continue developing their game.
credentials: 31 years as a tennis teaching professional

pros.name: Michael Kelly
pros.title: Tennis & Pickleball Professional
pros.about: Michael is a longtime tennis and pickleball player who brings his passion for both sports to his role as a Racquet Sports Instructor at The J. A lifelong Dallas resident, he is committed to helping strengthen The J's Racquet Sports program and creating an engaging, inviting, and enjoyable experience for players of every level.
pros.style: Michael wants players to enjoy being on the court while continuing to improve their game. His approach is welcoming and encouraging, with a focus on creating an environment where players of all levels feel comfortable learning, playing, and becoming part of the Racquet Sports community.
credentials: Married 32 years with two daughters and a granddaughter
